test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

Details of the housing / services and internment / has not been announced yet
solution:
The erroneous part is: **has not been announced yet**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 'Has not been' must be replaced by 'have not been' to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
• The subject 'Details of the housing/services and internment' is plural and requires a plural verb 'have'.

Hence, the corrected sentence is: *Details of the housing services and internment **have **not been announced yet.*
